## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass
- [ ] New logic in `plan` or `merge` has table tests
- [ ] Every new write path has a `--dry-run` branch
- [ ] Nothing prints or logs tokens, emails or file contents
- [ ] No network calls added
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated (under `[Unreleased]`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, ...)
